subject: science
cluster: What plants need and animal helpers

items.prompt:
Two things plants need to grow are
A) sunlight and water
B) rocks and sound
C) plastic and glass
D) darkness and salt

A plant in sunlight grows better than one in the dark. This shows plants need
A) sunlight
B) darkness
C) rocks
D) noise

steps: The plant with sunlight grew better.

items.prompt:
A plant with no water for two weeks will likely
A) grow tall
B) wilt and not grow well
C) turn into a rock
D) make seeds
items.answer: B) wilt and not grow well

items.prompt:
To test if sunlight matters, the only difference between two plants should be
A) their color
B) the sunlight
C) their names
D) the pot color

steps: Changing only sunlight makes a fair test.

items.prompt:
Why keep everything the same except one thing?
A) So any difference in growth comes from that one thing
B) To make it harder
C) To change the result
D) It does not matter
items.answer: A) So any difference in growth comes from that one thing

steps: Controlling the other conditions makes it fair.

items.prompt:
A plant kept in a dark closet turned pale and did not grow. It needed
A) sunlight
B) less water
C) more darkness
D) a bigger pot only

steps: It needed sunlight to grow well.

items.prompt:
A plant gets water but no sunlight. It will
A) grow well
B) not grow well
C) make its own sunlight
D) turn into an animal

steps: Without sunlight it will not grow well.

items.prompt:
The BEST way to find out if plants need water is to
A) water one plant and not another, keeping other things the same, and compare
B) water both the same
C) give neither water
D) guess
items.answer: A) water one plant and not another, keeping other things the same, and compare

steps: Changing only water shows if it is needed.
